about: Opt-in library skills, grouped into plugins of the local 'gigabrain' marketplace (library/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json). A skill listed here is written by bin/absorb-adapt.py to library/plugins/<plugin>/skills/<name>/ instead of library/skills/<name>/, so it loads only in projects that enable the plugin: claude plugin install <plugin>@gigabrain --scope local. Skills not listed stay global (symlinked into ~/.claude/skills by bin/install.sh). Plugin skills are invoked as /<plugin>:<skill>. Decided 2026-10-12 (roadmap phase 1).

homelab.description: Home network and network-device skills: Cisco IOS, Netmiko, BGP, interface health, config validation, VLANs, Pi-hole, WireGuard.

media.description: Generated media: Manim explainer animations and fal.ai image/video/audio generation.

content.description: Marketing and outreach: content engine, brand voice, email ops, SEO.

knowledge.description: Backend stack knowledge (opt-in): Postgres, Redis, NestJS, Node backend, migrations, REST API design, error handling. Retired from global 2026-10-14: evals showed no lift over vanilla.
